Set the dashboard's auto-refresh interval to 1m via the top-right refresh dropdown (URL updated to refresh=1m), then saved the dashboard in edit mode via Ctrl+S with the "Update default refresh value" checkbox checked — a "Dashboard saved" alert confirmed success. Verified by reloading the dashboard fresh at http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/ffwfjocnjeeioe/fwgr6-n3-bench-dashboard (no query params): (a) refresh interval shows "1m" in the top-right picker, (b) time range shows "Last 6 hours", and (c) no unsaved-changes indicator is present (dashboard is in view mode with no save/discard prompts).
